plan.title: Verify environment and package versions
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Install/pin ultralytics==8.1.0 if needed. Confirm GPU availability (A800 devices 2,3).
plan.success_criteria: All critical packages at correct versions, GPU confirmed available with device IDs

plan.title: Explore dataset structure and annotations
plan.description: Load data/train/annotations.json, count images, annotations, categories. Compute stats: annotations per image (min/max/mean/median), category frequency distribution, image dimensions. Examine data/metadata.json structure. List contents of data/products/ (how many product folders, what images exist per product).
plan.success_criteria: Full understanding of data: 248 images, ~22700 annotations, 357 categories, image sizes, product reference image availability

plan.title: Examine annotation quality and category distribution
plan.description: Analyze category frequency: how many categories have <5, <10, <20 annotations. Check for 'corrected' field in annotations. Examine bbox size distribution (width, height, area). Identify store sections from image metadata or filenames. Check if category_id=356 (unknown_product) has special treatment.
plan.success_criteria: Clear picture of class imbalance, bbox sizes, store sections, annotation quality flags

plan.title: Explore reference product images
plan.description: Sample 10-20 product folders in data/products/. Check image types available (main.jpg, front.jpg, etc.), image sizes, quality. Cross-reference with metadata.json to understand mapping between product codes and category_ids. Count how many of the 357 categories have reference images.
plan.success_criteria: Know reference image coverage, types, sizes, and mapping to category_ids

plan.title: Create stratified 90/10 train/val split
plan.description: Write a script to split annotations.json into train_split.json and val_split.json. Use seed=42, split by image. Stratify by store section (Egg, Frokost, Knekkebrod, Varmedrikker) if section info is available in image metadata/filenames. Ensure ~223 train, ~25 val images. Save as COCO-format JSON files.
plan.success_criteria: Two valid COCO JSON files with proportional section representation, all annotations for each image kept together

plan.title: Write evaluation function for val_score
plan.description: Implement evaluation using pycocotools COCOeval. Compute detection_mAP@0.5 (all predictions mapped to single category) and classification_mAP@0.5 (original category_ids). Combine as val_score = 0.7 * det_mAP + 0.3 * cls_mAP. Test with dummy predictions to verify correctness.
plan.success_criteria: Evaluation function returns correct val_score, tested with synthetic predictions

plan.title: Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format
plan.description: Write converter from COCO JSON to YOLO txt format (one txt per image, class x_center y_center width height normalized). Create dataset YAML config for ultralytics. Handle the train/val split properly.
plan.success_criteria: YOLO-format labels and dataset.yaml ready for training

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8n nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: A YOLOv8n baseline with 357 classes at 640px achieves val_score > 0.15
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n with nc=357, imgsz=640, 100 epochs, batch=16, on GPU. Use train split only. Run inference on val split, evaluate with the evaluation function. Record val_score, detection_mAP, classification_mAP, training time.
plan.success_criteria: Baseline val_score recorded, training completes successfully

plan.title: YOLOv8s nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8s improves over YOLOv8n by at least 0.03 val_score
plan.description: Train YOLOv8s with same settings as baseline. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over YOLOv8n recorded

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m further improves val_score over YOLOv8s
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=357, imgsz=640, 100 epochs. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison logged

plan.title: YOLOv8l nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8l provides meaningful improvement for 357 classes
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l with nc=357, imgsz=640, 150 epochs. Record val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison logged

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x is the best single YOLO model for this task
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=357, imgsz=640, 150 epochs. Record val_score. Determine best model size.
plan.success_criteria: Best YOLO model size identified

plan.title: Best YOLO model at 1280px resolution
plan.hypothesis: Higher resolution significantly improves detection on dense shelves with small products
plan.description: Take the best model size from steps 8-12, retrain at imgsz=1280. Reduce batch size as needed. Train 150-200 epochs. Compare val_score to 640px version.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from higher resolution quantified

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 (detection-only) at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector achieves higher detection_mAP than nc=357 since it doesn't need to distinguish classes
plan.description: Convert all annotations to category_id=0. Train YOLOv8x with nc=1, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 only. Compare detection recall to nc=357 model.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP comparison between nc=1 and nc=357 logged

plan.title: Longer training for best YOLO config
plan.hypothesis: Training for 300-500 epochs with close_mosaic=50 improves val_score
plan.description: Take the best YOLO configuration so far, train for 500 epochs with close_mosaic=50, patience=100. Use best hyperparameters found so far.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from longer training quantified

plan.title: Build DINOv2 embedding pipeline
plan.description: Implement DINOv2-base feature extraction: load model from torch hub or timm, extract CLS token embeddings for image crops. Build gallery from reference product images (data/products/) and training annotation crops. Implement kNN classifier (k=5, cosine similarity).
plan.success_criteria: DINOv2 pipeline extracts embeddings and performs kNN classification on crops

plan.title: DINOv2-base classification on ground-truth val crops
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings with kNN achieve >30% top-1 accuracy on val crops using reference + training gallery
plan.description: Extract ground-truth crops from val images using val annotations. Build gallery from training crops + reference images. Classify each val crop via kNN. Measure top-1 and top-5 accuracy.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy on GT crops measured, gallery quality assessed

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: YOLO detection + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: YOLO nc=1 detection + DINOv2 classification achieves higher val_score than YOLO nc=357 alone
plan.description: Run best nc=1 YOLO on val images to get detection boxes. Crop detections from original full-res images. Classify each crop with DINOv2 kNN. Evaluate full val_score (detection + classification).
plan.success_criteria: val_score of two-stage pipeline compared to single-stage YOLO nc=357

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO nc=357 + DINOv2 fallback
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves classification_mAP
plan.description: For each detection from YOLO nc=357: if YOLO class confidence > threshold, use YOLO class. Otherwise, use DINOv2 kNN classification. Sweep threshold on val split (0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9). Compare to pure YOLO and pure DINOv2.
plan.success_criteria: Best gating threshold found, val_score improvement quantified

plan.title: NMS and score threshold tuning
plan.hypothesis: Tuning NMS IoU threshold and confidence threshold improves detection_mAP on dense shelves
plan.description: Using best YOLO model, sweep NMS IoU threshold (0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8) and confidence threshold (0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.25) on val split. Record val_score for each combination.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal NMS/confidence thresholds identified

plan.title: Test-time augmentation (TTA)
plan.hypothesis: TTA adds +1-2 detection_mAP with acceptable inference time increase
plan.description: Run best YOLO model with augment=True on val split. Measure val_score improvement and inference time increase. Check if it fits within 300s budget for all test images.
plan.success_criteria: TTA val_score and timing recorded

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference on high-res images significantly improves detection of small products
plan.description: Implement tiled inference: slice each image into overlapping 1280×1280 tiles (stride 960), run YOLO on each tile + full image, merge with WBF. Test on val split. Measure val_score and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: Tiled inference val_score and timing recorded, compared to single-pass

plan.title: DINOv2 kNN hyperparameter tuning
plan.hypothesis: Tuning k, temperature, and distance weighting improves classification accuracy
plan.description: Sweep k (1, 3, 5, 7, 11), distance metric (cosine, L2), weighting (uniform, distance-weighted, temperature-scaled with T=0.01, 0.05, 0.1). Evaluate on val crops.
plan.success_criteria: Best kNN configuration identified

plan.title: Gallery composition optimization
plan.hypothesis: Optimal mix of reference images and training crops improves classification
plan.description: Test gallery variants: (a) reference images only, (b) training crops only, (c) both with equal weight, (d) training crops weighted 2x, (e) reference main/front images repeated 3x. Evaluate classification accuracy on val crops.
plan.success_criteria: Best gallery composition identified

plan.title: RT-DETR-l baseline
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l provides different error profile from YOLO, useful for ensemble
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l with nc=357, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs on train split. Evaluate val_score standalone. Compare to best YOLO model.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-l val_score recorded, comparison to YOLO logged

plan.title: WBF ensemble: YOLO + RT-DETR
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling YOLO and RT-DETR with WBF improves val_score by 2-4 points
plan.description: Run both best YOLO and RT-DETR on val images. Merge predictions using Weighted Boxes Fusion (ensemble-boxes). Sweep WBF IoU threshold (0.4-0.7) and model weights. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score exceeds best single model

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs DINOv2-base comparison
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large produces significantly better embeddings for fine-grained product classification
plan.description: Load DINOv2-large (ViT-L/14), build gallery, classify val crops. Compare classification accuracy to DINOv2-base. Estimate ONNX model size for budget planning.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy improvement quantified, model size recorded

plan.title: Fine-tuned projection head on DINOv2 embeddings
plan.hypothesis: A small MLP trained with ArcFace/SupCon loss on DINOv2 features improves classification by 5+ points
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2-base, add 2-layer MLP projection head. Train with ArcFace or supervised contrastive loss on training crops + reference images. Evaluate classification accuracy on val crops vs raw DINOv2 kNN.
plan.success_criteria: Projection head improves classification accuracy over raw embeddings

plan.title: Multi-crop DINOv2 inference
plan.hypothesis: Averaging embeddings from multiple crop variations improves robustness
plan.description: For each detection crop, extract 4 variations: original, center-zoomed (80% crop), padded (120%), horizontally flipped. Average embeddings before kNN lookup. Evaluate on val crops.
plan.success_criteria: Multi-crop classification accuracy compared to single-crop

plan.title: Training hyperparameter optimization for best YOLO
plan.hypothesis: Tuning lr0, lrf, mosaic, mixup, copy_paste, close_mosaic improves val_score
plan.description: Starting from best YOLO config, try: (a) lr0=0.005 vs 0.01 vs 0.02, (b) close_mosaic=100 vs 150, (c) mixup=0.1 vs 0.3, (d) copy_paste=0.1 vs 0.3, (e) label_smoothing=0.05 vs 0.1. Run each for 300 epochs.
plan.success_criteria: Best hyperparameter combination identified

plan.title: Progressive resizing training
plan.hypothesis: Training at 640 for 100 epochs then 1280 for 200 epochs is faster and potentially better than 1280 throughout
plan.description: Train best YOLO model: first 100 epochs at imgsz=640, then resume at imgsz=1280 for 200 more epochs. Compare val_score and total training time to training at 1280 throughout.
plan.success_criteria: Progressive resizing val_score and time compared to fixed resolution

plan.title: Train at 1600px resolution
plan.hypothesis: 1600px preserves more product detail than 1280px, improving detection of small items
plan.description: Train best YOLO model at imgsz=1600, reduced batch size with gradient accumulation. Train 300 epochs. Compare val_score to 1280px.
plan.success_criteria: val_score at 1600px compared to 1280px

plan.title: Rectangular inference mode
plan.hypothesis: rect=True preserves aspect ratio better and improves detection on non-square images
plan.description: Run best YOLO model with rect=True on val split. Compare val_score to square inference.
plan.success_criteria: Rectangular vs square inference val_score compared

plan.title: Class-balanced sampling / focal loss for rare categories
plan.hypothesis: Addressing class imbalance improves classification of rare categories
plan.description: Train YOLO with class-weighted loss or oversample images containing rare categories. Alternatively, use focal loss gamma=1.5 or 2.0. Compare classification_mAP to baseline.
plan.success_criteria: Impact of class balancing on classification_mAP measured

plan.title: Copy-paste augmentation from reference images
plan.hypothesis: Pasting reference product images onto shelf backgrounds improves rare category detection
plan.description: Implement copy-paste augmentation: extract product images from data/products/, apply perspective warps and lighting adjustments, paste onto training shelf images. Retrain best YOLO model. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Copy-paste augmentation impact on val_score measured

plan.title: Patch-level DINOv2 matching
plan.hypothesis: Matching individual patch tokens is more robust to occlusion than CLS token matching
plan.description: Instead of using only CLS token, extract all patch tokens from DINOv2. Implement patch-level matching (e.g., average of top-k most similar patches). Compare classification accuracy to CLS-only on val crops.
plan.success_criteria: Patch-level vs CLS-only classification accuracy compared

plan.title: Co-occurrence priors for classification
plan.hypothesis: Products on the same shelf section are correlated; using co-occurrence improves classification
plan.description: Build category co-occurrence matrix from training data (which categories appear in the same image). For each val image, after initial classification, apply Bayesian update using co-occurrence priors. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Co-occurrence prior impact on classification_mAP measured

plan.title: Per-category adaptive confidence thresholds
plan.hypothesis: Different categories need different confidence thresholds for optimal classification
plan.description: For each category, find optimal confidence threshold on val split. Categories with unique packaging can use lower thresholds; visually similar categories need higher thresholds. Fall back to category_id=0 when below threshold.
plan.success_criteria: Per-category thresholds improve classification_mAP

plan.title: ONNX export and inference time benchmarking
plan.hypothesis: ONNX inference is faster than PyTorch, helping fit within 300s budget
plan.description: Export best YOLO model to ONNX FP16 (opset ≤ 20). Export DINOv2 to ONNX FP16. Benchmark inference time on val split using onnxruntime-gpu. Compare to PyTorch inference time. Check total weight file sizes.
plan.success_criteria: ONNX inference time and model sizes recorded, fits within 300s and 420MB

plan.title: INT8 quantization of YOLO
plan.hypothesis: INT8 YOLO loses <0.5 mAP but saves significant model size
plan.description: Quantize best YOLO ONNX model to INT8 using onnxruntime quantization. Benchmark val_score and model size. Compare to FP16.
plan.success_criteria: INT8 val_score degradation and size savings quantified

plan.title: Multi-scale YOLO ensemble (640 + 1280)
plan.hypothesis: Running YOLO at both 640 and 1280 and merging catches products at different scales
plan.description: Run best YOLO at imgsz=640 and imgsz=1280 on val images. Merge with WBF. Compare val_score to single-scale.
plan.success_criteria: Multi-scale ensemble val_score compared to single-scale

plan.title: Tiled inference + full image ensemble
plan.hypothesis: Combining tiled and full-image predictions catches both small and large products
plan.description: Run YOLO on full image at 1280 + tiled at 1280 (tiles of 1280×1280 with stride 960). Merge all predictions with WBF. Evaluate val_score and timing.
plan.success_criteria: Combined tiled+full val_score exceeds either alone

plan.title: Smaller YOLO for tiling (YOLOv8m + tiles)
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m with more tiles is faster and potentially better than YOLOv8x with fewer tiles
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m at 1280. Run tiled inference with smaller stride (more tiles). Compare val_score and inference time to YOLOv8x tiled.
plan.success_criteria: Speed/accuracy tradeoff of smaller model + more tiles quantified

plan.title: Image preprocessing: CLAHE contrast enhancement
plan.hypothesis: CLAHE improves detection on poorly lit shelf images
plan.description: Apply CLAHE preprocessing to val images before detection. Compare val_score to unprocessed images.
plan.success_criteria: CLAHE impact on val_score measured

plan.title: Pseudo-labeling for gallery augmentation
plan.hypothesis: Adding high-confidence test-time crops to gallery improves classification of repeated products
plan.description: First pass: run full pipeline on val images. Second pass: add crops with score > 0.85 to DINOv2 gallery, re-classify all detections. Measure val_score improvement. (In production, this would be done on test images.)
plan.success_criteria: Pseudo-labeling impact on classification_mAP measured

plan.title: Spatial consistency post-processing
plan.hypothesis: Adjacent detections on the same shelf row are likely the same product; enforcing consistency improves classification
plan.description: After initial classification, group detections by approximate shelf row (similar y-coordinates). For each row, if multiple adjacent detections have similar embeddings, assign them the same category (majority vote). Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Spatial consistency impact on classification_mAP measured

plan.title: Assemble best pipeline configuration
plan.description: Based on all experiments, assemble the best configuration: best detector(s), best resolution, best classification method, best post-processing. Document all hyperparameters.
plan.success_criteria: Complete pipeline specification with all hyperparameters documented

plan.title: Full pipeline end-to-end validation
plan.hypothesis: The assembled best pipeline achieves the highest val_score seen
plan.description: Run the complete best pipeline on val split. Record final val_score, detection_mAP, classification_mAP, inference time, model sizes.
plan.success_criteria: Final val_score is the best achieved, inference fits within constraints

plan.title: Inference time stress test
plan.hypothesis: Full pipeline completes within 300s for ~248 images on simulated L4 constraints
plan.description: Time the full pipeline on all val images, extrapolate to full test set. Ensure total inference time < 300s. If too slow, identify bottlenecks and optimize (reduce tiles, use smaller model, batch processing).
plan.success_criteria: Estimated inference time for full test set < 300s

plan.title: Build submission run.py
plan.description: Write run.py that takes --input and --output args, loads models, runs inference on all images, outputs predictions.json in COCO format. Use pathlib (not os), json (not yaml). Ensure no blocked imports. Handle image_id extraction from filenames.
plan.success_criteria: run.py runs correctly on val images, produces valid predictions.json

plan.title: Validate submission format
plan.hypothesis: Submission predictions.json passes format validation
plan.description: Run run.py on val images, verify output format: correct JSON structure, valid image_ids, category_ids 0-356, bbox in [x,y,w,h] COCO format, scores 0-1. Re-evaluate with evaluation function to confirm val_score matches.
plan.success_criteria: Output format validated, val_score matches expected

plan.title: Package submission zip
plan.description: Create submission.zip with run.py, model weights (.pt or .onnx), gallery files, helper scripts. Verify total uncompressed size < 420MB, weight files ≤ 3 files and ≤ 420MB total.
plan.success_criteria: Valid submission zip within all size constraints

plan.title: RT-DETR-x training and comparison
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-x outperforms RT-DETR-l and provides better ensemble diversity
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-x with nc=357, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs. Compare to RT-DETR-l and best YOLO. Test in ensemble.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-x val_score and ensemble contribution measured

plan.title: Three-model ensemble: YOLO + RT-DETR + YOLO-tiled
plan.hypothesis: Three diverse models in ensemble outperform two-model ensemble
plan.description: Combine YOLOv8x@1280 + RT-DETR-l@1280 + YOLOv8x-tiled predictions with WBF. Sweep fusion parameters. Check if it fits within 420MB and 300s constraints.
plan.success_criteria: Three-model ensemble val_score compared to two-model, feasibility assessed

plan.title: Soft-NMS vs WBF comparison
plan.hypothesis: Soft-NMS may work better than WBF for single-model multi-scale fusion
plan.description: Compare Soft-NMS and WBF for merging multi-scale predictions from a single model. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Best fusion method identified for each scenario

plan.title: DINOv2 with register tokens (if available in timm 0.9.12)
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 with registers produces cleaner embeddings
plan.description: Check if DINOv2 with register tokens is available in timm 0.9.12. If so, compare embedding quality to standard DINOv2 on val crops.
plan.success_criteria: Register token DINOv2 availability checked, comparison made if available

plan.title: Embedding-weighted box fusion
plan.hypothesis: Using DINOv2 embedding agreement as additional signal in box fusion improves ensemble quality
plan.description: When merging overlapping boxes from multiple models, compute DINOv2 embedding similarity between the crops. Weight boxes higher when embeddings agree across models. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Embedding-weighted fusion val_score compared to standard WBF

plan.title: Corrected annotation weighting
plan.hypothesis: Upweighting corrected annotations improves model quality
plan.description: If annotations have 'corrected' field, duplicate corrected annotations 2-3x in training data. Retrain best YOLO model. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Impact of annotation quality weighting measured

plan.title: Final optimization pass
plan.description: Review all experiment results. Apply any remaining optimizations: batch inference for DINOv2, optimized NMS, pre-computed gallery tensors. Ensure run.py is clean and efficient.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline fully optimized, run.py finalized

plan.title: Document best configuration for human operator
plan.description: Write a summary of the best configuration: model architecture, training hyperparameters, resolution, augmentation settings, classification method, post-processing. Include the val_score and all component metrics. This is what the human will use to retrain on full data.
plan.success_criteria: Complete configuration document with all settings and val_score
